name: Supernatural Spy — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Supernatural Spy from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Supernatural Spy (Story)" but are not part of the Supernatural Spy entry, which is unchanged.

Quest (Roll a 1d4)
Criers show up near occult phenomena with suspicious frequency; you seek to learn what they have learned on a major topic such as extraplanetary studies, necrotic enrichment, or supernatural meteorology.
Aboleths are rumored to use gillmen and other servants (both knowing and unwitting) to monitor or manipulate events, and you intend to discover more about the aboleth ability to transform other creatures.
You seek to discover the terms of an infernal pact to secure rulership and to learn more about infernal magic.
A priest charges you with hunting down a powerful divination spell lost long ago and rumored to have been found and sold by merchants to an unknown buyer.
